name: lolPing Lite
description: Desktop-wide ping and local emote wheels with native sound, offline emote packs and DBX-integrated settings.
releaseNotes: Initial release. Local desktop pings, emotes and settings; no rooms or network synchronization. Rust/WebView sidecar and the upstream C++ input helper replace Electron. Code is MIT licensed; Riot game assets and the upstream icon are excluded from that license.

zh-CN.name: lolPing 轻量版
zh-CN.description: 全桌面信号与本地表情轮盘，支持原生音效、离线扩展包与 DBX 内设置。
